pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **Rafe, if you spent more time studying soccer and less time doodling on the back of your algebra homework, you might not be languishing in last place.** Look, France against England is another gift for Gunner, a.k.a. "Bubba G" — and that’s no surprise because France is a juggernaut. Gayden, or should I say "The Backpass Assassin," is about to witness another embarrassing spectacle. His England, fresh off a defeat to Argentina, is stumbling like a drunkard trying to find a light switch. France will dismantle them, plain and simple.  Gunner knew to trust in the French. Devin's sitting pretty at the top of the standings because he actually understands the game; there's no competition here. This fantasy league is a showcase of amateur hour, and unless your name is Devin, you're lost. And Rafe, "The Noisemaker" – how you thought Germany, Ecuador, and Tunisia could bail you out is beyond me. Do you even watch the matches, or just pick teams that sound good?

pundit_takes.headline: Gunner's France Set to Make Light Work of Gayden's England
pundit_takes.subtitle: Bubba G's method still more scientific than The Backpass Assassin's luck.
